meso.prompt: Which conclusion best fits the job clues you examined?
options: Tools help identify jobs but do not establish equal status
Tools establish social rank without any other evidence
Shared work means all residents had equal political power
Different jobs mean households did not depend on others
meso.explanation: A tool’s use is evidence about work, not proof of equal power or complete social rank.

egypt.prompt: Which conclusion best fits the farming sequence you tested?
options: Harvesting should precede sowing once water recedes
Farm work follows changes in river and land conditions
Floodwater should cover fields throughout crop growth
A finished harvest reaches city stores without transport
egypt.explanation: Successful farming follows the flood cycle and crop sequence, and harvested grain still needs delivery.

indus.prompt: Which conclusion best fits the drainage connections you tested?
options: A closed indoor loop carries wastewater out of the city
A bathroom’s outer wall alone proves drainage is connected
Connected house and street drains carry wastewater away
One working drain establishes every household’s routine
indus.explanation: A continuous outward route supports wastewater removal, not claims about every household.

china.prompt: Which conclusion best fits the records and objects you examined?
options: Carved records verify every divination prediction as science
Using bronze proves vessels and weapons had one function
A model supplies exact translations of every carved sign
Shang records offer evidence of beliefs and record-keeping
china.explanation: Records provide sources for studying Shang beliefs and recording, not guaranteed predictions or invented translations.
